items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Practically everyone - Power, Bob Power, Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Lester Young, Gene Ammons, all those guys.

ctx.x: You were one of the first to play there?
Practically everyone - Power, Bob Power, Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Lester Young, Gene Ammons, all those guys.
But it - I know Tito Puente played there in 1953. Had you played Birdland before '53.
